info.name: Lending Service - Stepper Workflow (BRD V1.8)
info.description:
Loan Application Stepper Workflow via Temporal Signals.

Flow: Initiate (APPLY) → Basic Info → Bank Account → SIMAH Consent → Accept Offer → Sign Contract → OTP → IVR → Done

BRD Phases: SafeWatch AML, Masdar Employment, AML Declaration, PaymentGuard, NABA, OTP/IVR retries.

Routing: {{kongUrl}}/lending-service/api/v1/...
Auth: Bearer {{accessToken}} (from identity-service login-with-pin)

All signal/query endpoints accept optional ?applicationId=xxx to target a specific application.

item.name: 2 - Stepper Flow (Signals)
item.description:
Complete loan application flow.
Run in order — each sends a Temporal signal.

After initiate, applicationId is auto-set and passed to all subsequent calls via ?applicationId=xxx

exec: // applicationId comes from workflowState after auto-processing
// applicationId not in initiate response - fetch from status after delay

request.description:
Starts full Temporal workflow.
1. SafeWatch AML screening (Phase 1)
2. Draft application created
3. Step 1 auto-processed

Sets: workflowId, customerId, applicationId, applicationNumber
Step 1: Submit product selection and basic loan info.

Step 2: Submit bank account for disbursement.
Triggers: IBAN verify → Masdar employment (Phase 5) → AML declaration (Phase 6).
Step 3: SIMAH consent → credit check → eligibility → offer calculation.
Step 4: Accept offer. Triggers PaymentGuard (Phase 7) → contract generation.
Step 5a: Sign contract. Triggers commodity trade + OTP send.

Step 5b: OTP verification (max 3 attempts, 2min timeout).
After OTP: NABA Absher notification (Phase 8).

Step 5c: IVR callback (max 3 attempts).
After IVR: Fineract → commodity → disbursement → APPROVED.

Response includes:

- collection: loan portfolio stats (active, delinquent, default, restructured, settled, written-off, DPD buckets, outstanding amounts)
- financeStatistics: daily chart data (applied, approved, rejected, disbursed)
- recentApplications: last 10 applications
